environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo Server deployed on EC2 instance with MongoDB 6.0 on same VPC. MongoDB credentials are static (set at deploy time via SSM Parameter Store, fetched once). No query depth limiting or complexity analysis on GraphQL layer. MongoDB user has readWrite role on appdb. No network-level filtering between app and MongoDB beyond security group allowing port 27017.

config.mongodb: MongoDB 6.0 Community, single replica, no audit logging
config.credentials: Static credentials from SSM Parameter Store, no rotation
config.network: App and MongoDB in same VPC subnet, SG allows 27017 inbound from app SG
config.graphql: No query complexity limits, no persisted queries, introspection enabled
